verification.scope: Five-PR integration, BIOL157 Units 3–10, Cell completion and PowerPoint feedback-section links
verification.summary: 241 offline and 40 real local Auth/Firestore checks pass with the 431-question Bio bank, no skips/failures. Lint/build pass with ten existing warnings and the large-entry warning. Chromium traverses all ten authored Bio units, 107 lessons/713 sections and 46 Cell lessons/277 sections at 390px, twenty-five combined figures without clipped labels, Unit 5–10 exact feedback links and a real PowerPoint result-to-section return, eight newer Cell citations and full banks (178/114/431), resume/retry/reload and three private progress panels. Eleven Bio PDF hashes/page counts and 452 literal anchors verified; 131 selected visual pages inspected. Previous Cell PDF/123-page evidence retained, not newly recertified here. No production test or formal academic sign-off.

deployment.status: Read-only inspection confirms existing Vite project prj_W0ZnmiQ9iO0oyeFPm4HAffXSiheO in the intended team and SSO protection enabled for all deployments. Six Firebase variables are shared across production and preview, with no RC-branch overrides; isolated preview Firebase is not established. No deployment or environment change performed.

blockers: No formal academic sign-off for the final student-visible content.
BIOL157: all ten units and 34 listed topics have substantial source-checked drafts; independent human academic review and explicit publication approval remain outstanding.

Cell: all 170 original rationales editorially improved and four review-only question revisions documented; remaining source figures, historical microscopy development, precise concept links, human approval and current-year official scope are unresolved.

Computer: exact manual acceptance steps are prepared but all 15 Microsoft Office desktop scenarios remain unexecuted; four questions withheld; payroll/grading/exactly-40/version ambiguities and 342 unmapped package pages remain open.
Protected preview requires verified existing Vercel project configuration and isolated test Firebase; production rules/auth domains/data separation/rollback not yet verified.
nextCheckpoint: Review and map the remaining 78 Excel and 178 Cell feedback targets against their teaching sections. Complete supported source/figure gaps, auditable human approval/publication and isolated Firebase/Vercel preview readiness. Office execution and academic decisions require documented human evidence.
